_comment: Large inputs hosted outside git, fetched by scripts/download_data.py.
Fill in 'drive_id' with the Google Drive file id (the FILE_ID in a
direct HTTP(S) download. Sizes and SHA-256 sums are verified after every
download so a truncated transfer cannot silently change the results.
Nothing here is needed to redraw the published figures: those come from

files.name: 2024 North Atlantic ERA5 storm archive
files.description: 19 storms x (dataset.pkl + spatial_1000km.pkl). Required to run the CNN in scripts/run_single_track.py. Extracts to data/training_data/2024/<storm>/ and the tar is deleted afterwards.

files.name: chi_s_flossie.nc
files.description: Per-member chi and S for the 492-member Flossie ensemble. Supplies the ventilation panel of the Flossie figure; the intensity panel works without it.

files.name: chi_s_priscilla.nc
files.description: Per-member chi and S for the Priscilla ensemble (1000 members archived; the first 460 were integrated and are the ones plotted). Supplies the ventilation panel of the Priscilla figure.
